verdict.line: You lose if you trade into her E (Flawless Duet) stun-chain before level 6, and you win if you force stand-and-trade fights with E (Test of Spirit) once your R (Leap of Faith) is live.

brief.thesis: This is a genuinely even matchup (49.7% over 505 games) built around one tension: Irelia wants short, mobile trades that stack her passive and refresh her Q, while Illaoi wants to pin her in place with E (Test of Spirit) and win the stand-and-trade. Whoever dictates which fight happens wins the lane.

theirWindow.what: Irelia's E (Flawless Duet) stuns and Marks anything caught between the converging blades, and a Marked target lets her Q (Bladesurge) refresh on hit or kill — that's her full combo. Don't stand where both blades can converge on you in the wave; step through minions at an angle so only one blade threatens you.

yourWindow.when: Level 6+, once she commits to close
yourWindow.what: When she dashes in with Q or commits to a charged W (Defiant Dance), answer with E (Test of Spirit) to tether her spirit, then R (Leap of Faith) — the AoE damage plus a tentacle spawned on her turns her engage into a fight she can't cleanly dash out of.

powerCurve.note: poke phase, trade E pokes only
her E-Q stun combo punishes extended trades
your R answers her all-in engage

start.why: Highest-performing start into her (50.5% over 368 games, 59.7% pick) — the extra sustain and damage let you match her short trade pattern instead of losing the attrition war.

boots.why: Runs 50.2% over 450 games at 79.5% pick; flat damage reduction on autos blunts both her Q-dash auto and her passive's on-hit spike at max Ionian Fervor stacks.

core.why: Spellblade proc off your W (Harsh Lesson) leap adds a slow, which helps you stick to her after you've committed to E-R.
Stacking armor shred from Q/W/tentacle hits lets you burst through her without needing to out-mobility her.
Survives the burst window when she lands her full E-Q-R combo at and after level 6.

situational.when: irelia's passive stacks are snowballing your trades and her on-hit damage is outpacing your healing
she's leaning on q's self-heal to win extended trades against you
you're already ahead and want more tenacity plus healing amp to close out the lane

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the prolonged, stand-in-place trades you're forcing with E — each proc heals you and adds permanent max health, directly countering her plan to win short burst exchanges.

summoners.why: Flash + Teleport is the default (50.5% win rate, 48.1% pick) for wave management and side-lane pressure with your tentacles. Swap to Exhaust + Flash (50.2%, 32.9% pick) when you expect her to fully commit her E-Q-R combo — Exhaust cuts the attack speed and damage of that all-in.

playing.title: Angle through waves vs E
playing.detail: Don't stand where both Flawless Duet blades can converge on you inside the minion wave; step through at an angle so only one blade can reach you and deny the stun setup.

playing.title: Punish her Q cooldown
playing.detail: Bladesurge is her only gap closer and reset (10/9/8/7/6s cd); when it's down she can't cleanly escape your W leap or dodge your E's spirit tether.

playing.title: Hold E for committed fights
playing.detail: Test of Spirit turns her into a Vessel spawning tentacles if she dies or runs too far from the spirit — save it for moments she's already engaged rather than as pure poke.

playing.title: Save R for her commit
playing.detail: Leap of Faith (120/95/70/70/70s cd) is best spent the instant she dashes in with Q or charges W into you, converting her engage into a losing fight for her.

playing.title: Track her passive stacks
playing.detail: At max Ionian Fervor she gains bonus attack speed and on-hit damage — end extended trades before she caps stacks, not after.

playing.title: Don't trade into a charging W
playing.detail: Defiant Dance deals more damage the longer she charges it and reduces the physical damage she takes while charging; back off or interrupt with your W leap instead of auto-trading.

playing.title: Play patient before 6
playing.detail: Before level 6 her E-into-Q combo hits hardest without your R to punish the commit — stick to E pokes and wave management rather than forcing all-ins.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, boots, runes, and summoners above are pulled from measured games on the current patch via OP.GG across 505 head-to-head Illaoi vs Irelia games; the tactical reasoning — ability tells, trade windows, and power spikes — is my own read of the kits.

stats.opponentTip: Even though Illaoi is strong in melee fights, an Irelia with 5 stacks of (P) flips the odds in her favor. Try to harass Irelia through [E] without allowing her to close in before reaching level 6, and engage with [E]-[R] if Irelia closes in after reaching level 6.
